cases.name: Marcia Louise Linsky
cases.about: She was a former prosecutor and magistrate. At the time of her death, she was a defense attorney with Close & Hitchcock, LLP.
cases.narrative: In addition to the wound on her neck, she had apparent stab wounds that went through her shirt, as well as cuts on her lip. Her thumb was "severely cut, to the point it was nearly severed."
